technical_and_design_decisions: Use the Hortonworks Teradata Connector as the basis for the Teradata connection manager implementation.
Externalize the logging directory configuration via a new property (e.g., xd.log.dir) instead of hardcoding ${xd.home}/logs.
Refactor message-bus, serialization codec, and type conversion modules into separate repositories (spring-bus and spring-cloud-dataflow) using Maven multi-module projects.
Implement the single-node XD Admin SPI using an embedded module launcher within a single JVM.
Integrate Diego Receptor API for the CF Lattice/Diego-based XD Admin SPI implementation.
Use Spring Cloud Service Discovery for self-registration of s-c-s modules.
assumptions: The Hortonworks Teradata Connector is compatible with the existing Sqoop version in Spring XD.
Existing unit and integration tests for message-bus and type conversion can be reused after refactoring.
Maven is the primary build tool for dependency management and project structure.
The development team has prior experience with Spring XD, Spring Cloud, and Cloud Foundry Diego.
Service discovery integration for s-c-s modules will use Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka or Consul.
All user stories are independent and can be developed in parallel where possible.

activities.activity_name: Implement Teradata Connection Manager for Sqoop
activities.activity_description: Integrate the Hortonworks Teradata Connector into Spring XD to resolve the NPE when connecting to Teradata via Sqoop import jobs.
Modify Spring XD to allow the logging directory to be configured outside of xd.home via a new property.
Extract the message-bus module from Spring XD into a standalone spring-bus repository and update dependencies.

activities.activity_name: Move Input/Output Type Conversion to Spring-Cloud-Dataflow
activities.activity_description: Relocate type conversion logic from Spring XD to spring-cloud-dataflow to enable custom module development.
Refactor the serialization codec module from Spring XD into spring-bus for reuse via Maven dependencies.

activities.activity_name: Develop Single-Node XD Admin SPI Implementation
activities.activity_description: Create a single-JVM implementation of the XD Admin SPI using an embedded module launcher for local data pipeline use cases.

activities.activity_name: Implement Diego-Based Receptor for XD Admin SPI
activities.activity_description: Develop a Receptor implementation for the XD Admin SPI to support data pipelines on CF Lattice/Diego.

activities.activity_name: Investigate s-c-s Module Self-Registration to Service Discovery
activities.activity_description: Research and prototype self-registration of Spring Cloud Stream modules to service discovery for orchestration via Spring XD runtime.
